{{Quote|I always told your father that you were a good boy.|Antan Azzameen|audio=AceAntanGoodBoy-XWA.flac|<ref name="xwa" />}}
'''Ace Azzameen''' {{Pronounced|Ās Ă'-zämēn}}<ref name="negtc">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who became a highly regarded [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Starting out as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] pilot for his [[Azzameen family|family's]] business, [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]], Azzameen was pulled into the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when his [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|father]] and [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|older brother]] [[Death/Legends|perished]] while docked with the hidden Rebel [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|''Hospital'']] during a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] [[Battle of Hospital|delivery]]. On the run from both the Empire and the family's rivals, [[Viraxo Industries]], Azzameen, his brother [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]], his sister [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]], and the family [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]], sought refuge with the [[Defiance Task Force|''Defiance'' Task Force]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]].

Azzameen, despite the objections of his Uncle [[Antan Azzameen|Antan]], joined the Alliance as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilot and aided the [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] in its flight from the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Upon transferring to the [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], Azzameen fought off threats such as the [[TIE Experimental Project]] and helped with the defection of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zaletta]]. He became involved with the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] and aided Commander [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in stealing the [[Death Star II plans]]. Additionally, he still aided his siblings in their private fight against the Viraxo, which even led to him becoming caught up with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Azzameen eventually helped the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] mass their forces at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], and also served aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] during the pivotal [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
===Working for the family business===
The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="xwa" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] Ace Azzameen<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> grew up during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]] on the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Home Base]], where<ref name="xwa" /> he<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> would often use the station's [[Flight simulator/Legends|flight simulator]] to pass the [[Time/Legends|time]]. The youngest member of the [[Azzameen family]], Ace lived with his [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas]], his older brothers [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]] and [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]], his sister [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]], and the family [[MK-series maintenance droid|MK-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]], or Emkay as he was often called by the family. Ace was particularly close to Aeron, who would often look out for him in seemingly dire situations.<ref name="xwa" /> Tomaas was the co-founder, along with his brother, [[Antan Azzameen]], and head of the shipping company [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]].<ref name="LA">{{LucasArts|url=products/alliance/xwa_characters.htm|text=XWA: Characters}}</ref> As such there were many [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] passing through the Home Base, which only fueled Ace's desire to fly,<ref name="xwa" /> although his duties with the family business were initially limited to maintenance tasks.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

====First missions for the family====
{{Quote|Way to go, hotshot!|MK-09, referring to Azzameen's piloting|audio=AceEmkayHotshot-XWA.flac|<ref name="xwa" />}}
[[File:Ace1stmission-dat15210-1-XWA.png|thumb|left|220px|Azzameen flies the ''Sabra'' on his first mission.]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dating">The events of the prologue mission of ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' take place after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] but before the [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards]]. This [[Time/Legends|time]] period corresponds to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> after Tomaas and Galin were forced to escape the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at the onset of an [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|attack]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Following the debacle at Hoth, Antan decided that it was time to allow Ace to put his simulator skills into practice in the real world,<ref name="xwa" /> giving him his first real opportunity to contribute to the family business.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

The siblings took the family's matching [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], with Aeron in the ''[[Selu]]'' and Ace and MK-09 in the ''[[Sabra]]'',<ref name="xwa" /> Ace took his first trip through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> as he delivered some supplies to the [[XQ1 Platform]] [[Harlequin Station]]. Exchanging them at the station for [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] and [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]] intended for the ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', Tomaas Azzameen's [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]], the two Azzameen ships prepared to leave just as two [[Viraxo Industries]] [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ships]], the ''[[Enkidu]]'' and the ''[[Gilgam]]'', entered the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and approached the station on an attack vector. The [[Director of Harlequin Station|station's Director]] hurriedly contacted Ace and Aeron, begging them for help. Harlequin's own defensive craft, the [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] ''[[Kouerd]]'', had been bought off by the Viraxo, leaving the station defenseless and vulnerable. While Aeron was apprehensive, MK-09 longed for some excitement, and Ace obliged. Attacking the Viraxo ships, the Azzameens were able to drive off the ''Pursuer''s, earning them the gratitude of the Director. Following the skirmish, the Azzameen collected the coolant and fuel cells and returned home. Shortly thereafter, Ace was awarded the key to Harlequin Station by [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Brauken]], as a token of appreciation.<ref name="xwa" />

Antan, concerned that Ace's actions at Harlequin Station would provoke [[K'Armyn Viraxo]], leader of the rival shipping company Viraxo Industries, into directly attacking the Azzameens, requested that Emon teach Ace basic [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] skills. With MK-09 [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] the ''Sabra'', Ace used the ship's [[Turret/Legends|turret]] to destroy Emon's planted [[Target drone/Legends|target drones]], before Emon helped him clear a field of junk containers. Impressed, Emon offered to buy Ace a drink at [[Dunari's Rest]]. Upon reaching the [[Casino/Legends|casino]], however, they came across the ''Enkidu'', complete with fighter escort. Emon, hungry for battle, raced towards the ''Enkidu'' in his ship, the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]] ''[[Andrasta]]'', and [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] it. Eager to get another shot at the ''Enkidu'', MK-09 followed suit, and Ace was able to help pick off the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] escort. The ''Enkidu'' was able to escape to hyperspace, but [[Dunari]]'s officials requested that Emon and MK-09 leave the system. The Azzameens complied, but Emon kept his promise, giving Ace a token for a drink at the casino.<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:XWA_Space_Pirate_Flag.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Flag retrieved from wreckage of mercenary vessel raiding Azzameen cargo area]]
By then properly versed in piloting outside the holosimulator, Ace was enlisted by Aeron for aid in cataloging three [[Azzameen cargo fields|container storage areas]], the records for which she had accidentally destroyed while upgrading Azzameen Station's systems. Aeron took the ''Selu'', with Ace flying the ''Sabra'' and MK-09 as his copilot, as the pair of ships made their way to the first area. After completing their scans without incident, the Azzameens entered the second location and stumbled across the [[cargo ferry]] [[Raider (cargo ferry)|''Raider'']] attempting to steal a [[pressure tank]] full of liquid [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. The Azzameens were able to rout the intruding ship, but upon arrival in the third location, Ace and Aeron once again came across the ''Enkidu''.<ref name="xwa" /> Rushing to engage, the pair forced the withdrawal of the Viraxo ship and the destruction of its fighter escort.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Continuing their inspection mission, the Azzameens discovered that the ''Enkidu'' had planted [[Spice/Legends|spice]] into a container in order to frame the Azzameens for possession of the illicit substance. Frustrated, Aeron retrieved the spice and returned home with the knowledge that their container storage areas had been compromised.<ref name="xwa" />

====Challenging the Viraxo====
[[File:Viraxo54-dat15210-4-XWA.png|thumb|left|220px|Ace and Emon Azzameen attack Viraxo 54.]]
Antan was outraged at Ace's transgressions against the Viraxo at Harlequin but was even more disgusted at the Viraxo and their underhanded tactics. Together with Aeron and Emon, he devised a plan in which Aeron, piloting the ''Selu'' under the [[transponder]] alias of the ''[[Venix]]''&mdash;one of the Viraxo's regular suppliers&mdash;would dump the Viraxos' planted spice container at the orbital [[Cargo Facility 1|cargo facility]] [[Viraxo 54]], near the planet [[Denbo]]. Ace and Emon were to arrive shortly after in the ''Sabra'' and the ''Andrasta'' respectively, launching a small [[Raid on Viraxo 54|"hit and fade" attack]] on the outpost, covering Aeron's departure and prompting an investigation by the local Imperial garrison. It was Antan's hope that the Imperials would discover the spice and that Viraxo would be forced to pay copious amounts in fines and bribes, or even be forced out of business permanently.<ref name="xwa" />

Unfortunately for the Azzameens, the gambit did not work as planned. Emon and Ace entered the [[Denbo system/Legends|Denbo system]] far too early, while Aeron attempted to convince those in charge of the outpost that her delivery was legitimate. Hoping to salvage the situation, Emon and Ace hurtled into the Viraxo defenses, engaging [[Razor-class starfighter|''Razor''-class starfighters]] in a frenzied firefight near the main depot. The ''Enkidu'' was present and Ace demolished the ''Pursuer''-class ship, much to the joy of the frustrated Azzameens. Aeron seized the moment, dumping her cargo and preparing to flee the system. However, the remaining Viraxo craft disabled the ''Selu'', forcing her to abandon the ship. She was picked up by Emon, while Ace destroyed the ''Selu'' to prevent it becoming a Viraxo asset, and the Azzameens safely departed before the Imperials arrived to investigate. Antan was pleased with the overall outcome despite the loss of the ''Selu'' and felt that Tomaas would be proud of his children upon his return.<ref name="xwa" />

====Imperial entanglements====
[[File:Ace_and_MK.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Azzameen and MK-09 fly the ''Otana''.]]
Tomaas, however, condemned the family's actions against the Viraxo, ordering a halt to any future operations like the Viraxo 54 incident, as he desired a more diplomatic approach. He was impressed with his children's abilities and requested that they assist in his mission to supply the Alliance. He had planned a [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] transfer near [[Saruwen Station]] from an unidentified [[Black market/Legends|black market]] dealer, enlisting Ace, Emon, and Aeron to fly cover for him.<ref name="xwa" /> Setting out in the ''Sabra'', once again, with Aeron in the ''Otana'', Emon in the ''Andrasta'' and Tomaas with Galin in the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Vasudra]]'', the group met their contact at Saruwen. Progressing to the transfer point, the ''Vasudra'' docked with the [[Xiytiar-class heavy transport/Legends|''Xiytiar''-class transport]] [[End Run (Xiytiar-class)|''End Run'']], and the bacta transfer ensued. The ''End Run''{{'s}} technicians, however, feigned a fault, and sent out Zero-G workers to investigate.<ref name="xwa" />

Emon was the first of the group to detect the ruse, just as the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigate]] ''[[Loose Cannon]]'' emerged from hyperspace. The Azzameens, realizing that the transfer was a trap, rushed to engage the enemy forces, while Tomaas and Galin fought the crew of the ''End Run''. Ace was able to destroy the spacebound workers and help destroy the ''Loose Cannon'', its [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] escort, and the [[Ravenno|contact's ship]]. Tomaas was able to obtain the bacta from the ''End Run'', and the family returned home safely. Tomaas was very proud of his children, and was given renewed confidence to approach Antan with the proposition of joining the Alliance wholesale. Antan was the only member of the family who was opposed to the Rebellion, and he put up a great deal of resistance to Tomaas' attempted assistance.<ref name="xwa" />

His confidence boosted, Tomaas prepared to deliver the bacta to the Alliance, and let Ace fly the ''Otana'' as a sign of his new faith in the boy. Ace, Tomaas, Galin, and Emon set out to the [[Golan Space Colony 3|space station]] [[Brint-wo Colony]] to meet with [[Olin Garn]], Aeron's friend and the Azzameens' contact in the Alliance. Garn led them to the [[XQ2 Platform]] [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|''Hospital'']], where the ''Vasudra'' began its bacta transfer. Halfway through the transfer, an [[Corrupter Task Force|Imperial strike force]] entered the system, led by the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']]. As [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garreth Holtz/Legends|Garreth Holtz]] broadcast his request for the surrender of the Rebel craft, the Alliance command on ''Hospital'' demanded that the ''Andrasta'' and the ''Otana'' join their fighter screen, and that command of the ''Vasudra'' be turned over. Tomaas grudgingly obliged, despite Emon and Galin's objections, as he feared that the Alliance suspected the Azzameens in leading the Empire to their hidden facility.<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:BattleOfHospital-dat15210-6-XWA.png|thumb|left|220px|Azzameen prepares to defend ''Hospital'' in the ''Otana''.]]
Ace, in the ''Otana'', [[Battle of Hospital|covered]] the evacuation of the Rebel craft, but as the ''Corrupter'' began launching more craft, Emon ordered Ace to leave the system. The ''Vasudra'', stranded after attacks from Imperial ships, appeared to be destroyed along with Tomaas and Galin just as the ''Otana'' and ''Andrasta'' escaped the system. Emon and Ace were able to make it back to the Azzameen Home Base, but only with the knowledge that their father and brother were likely dead. Antan, while mourning, was exceptionally frustrated, and though he did not blame Ace, he continued to decry Tomaas' choices. Preparing for the worst, the family expected the liquidation of Twin Suns Transport Services, and the seizure of the Home Base.<ref name="xwa" />

====Fractured family====
The Empire [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|responded]] by issuing warrants for all members of the Azzameen family.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Antan's contacts informed him that the Imperials were planning to move against Twin Suns and the Azzameens, and to transfer all holdings over to the Viraxo. Desperate, hoping to keep the family together, Antan made plans to retrieve all he could from Azzameen holdings before moving to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. He let all of the employees go, and had Azzameen Station evacuated and its [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] sabotaged to cause trouble for invading forces. Ordering Ace and Aeron to secure [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] and valuables from the family's orbital repair yard [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Suns Station]], he and Emon retrieved valuable resources from a variety of Twin Sun holding areas.<ref name="xwa" />

At Twin Sun Station, Aeron and Ace set about their task with little resistance, but upon retrieval of the warheads, an Imperial/Viraxo force entered the area and began to bombard the facility.<ref name="xwa" /> Ace began to engage the enemy, but a hit on the ''Otana'' from the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Blast Radius]]'' forced him to disengage and follow Aeron to hyperspace. Making it back to the Home Base safely for the rendezvous with Emon and Antan, Ace determined that the warheads had escaped damage during the previous skirmish. When MK-09 began to suggest a better strategy, Ace responded by shutting down the droid's communication systems.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> After a short period of waiting, a Viraxo Razor Fighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] attacked the ''Otana'' and the ''Sabra'', though they were easily defeated. Eventually, Emon arrived, with the news that Antan had been captured by Viraxo forces. Since Antan had been the only one who knew where they were headed, the siblings deliberated about their future course of action. Their ponderings were cut short, however, when the ''Corrupter'' entered the area and bombarded the Home Base, while launching wing after wing of fighters to halt, capture, or destroy the Azzameens. In the heat of their flight from the Imperials, Aeron remembered that Olin Garn had given her the coordinates of the Alliance's [[Defiance Task Force|''Defiance'' Task Force]], and suggested that they look to the Alliance for help. Emon was skeptical, but nevertheless agreed, and the three remaining Azzameens, along with MK-09, safely evaded the ''Corrupter'' and sought refuge with the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']].<ref name="xwa" />

===Joining the Rebellion===
{{Quote|I've missed you, kiddo, since you joined the Rebellion. I hear of so much activity going on&hellip; I worry about you.''"<br />"''Do you worry about me, too?''"<br />"''Of course I do, Emkay. You're expensive to repair.''"<br />"''I will delete that remark from my memory banks.|Aeron and MK-09 discuss her concerns about the action Ace got into as a member of the Alliance.|audio=R030501-5.flac|<ref name="xwa" />}}
[[File:AceJoinRebel-dat15210-2100-XWA.png|thumb|right|300px|The Azzameens join the Rebellion.]]
The Azzameens soon went their separate ways. Emon set out to establish a new base of operations while Aeron worked to consolidate the family's assets. Ace, however, chose to remain with the Rebels and,<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> with Olin Garn's aid, joined the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] as a starfighter pilot. Azzameen was stationed on the ''Defiance'', by then based at a space station known as [[Lost Station]], where he was run through a pair of tests to discern his suitability for recruitment as a starfighter pilot. The first test involved deep space [[Bomber/Legends|bombing]] strikes, where several mock situations, based on historical raids, were played out. Azzameen successfully demolished an Imperial [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas factory, a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] in dry dock, and a lightly defended convoy. His next test was a [[Starfighter Superiority Evaluation]], in which he and his instructor, Garn, would engage wave after wave of Imperial fighters in more mock situations. Azzameen passed his test, and became a certified pilot in the Alliance.<ref name="xwa" /> After qualifying, Azzameen spent some time practicing his skills in the unofficial obstacle course known as the [[pilot proving grounds]], achieving scores that compared well to some of the Alliance's best pilots. Azzameen would recount his experiences on the proving grounds to MK-09, which the droid then compiled in a memoir of his time with Ace.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

====With the ''Defiance'' Task Force====
The ''Defiance'' Task Force was, at the time of Azzameen's ascension into the ranks, pinned down in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] by an opposing Imperial task force. Alliance Admiral [[Nammo]] had been able to recover a significant portion of those who had escaped the chaos at Hoth, and needed to reunite Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and the bulk of the Rebel fleet. Feeling that spreading the Imperials thin was the wisest tactic, Nammo dispatched a group of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] to demolish an Imperial convoy. His hope was that the Imperials would assign more craft to the escort of supply convoys, in turn detracting from their efforts to find the Rebels. Azzameen flew with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] in a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], covering Green Squadron's attack. Nammo's gambit succeeded, and the convoy was totally [[Destruction of the Scythe convoy|obliterated]].<ref name="xwa" />

Though Ace was often the only Azzameen asset located aboard the ''Defiance'', MK-09 would visit often, bringing the ''Otana'' to whenever he was needed and acting as Ace's regular gunner.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Shortly after the destruction of the supply convoy, Emon contacted Ace with intelligence on their captured uncle's location aboard the Viraxo space station [[Viraxo Industries (platform)|Viraxo Industries]]. Fortunately for the Azzameens, the family had placed a mole on the station in [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, making his [[Rescue of Antan Azzameen|rescue]] somewhat easier. Emon was able to distract the station's defensive garrison of [[Planetary Defender starfighter]]s while Ace docked the ''Otana'' with the station, sending MK-09 in to rescue Antan. The operation was a success, and Antan was freed. As a sign of gratitude, Antan gave Ace his prized [[Jar'Kai dueling saber]]s.<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:AceScouting-XWA-DAT15210-12.png|thumb|left|220px|Azzameen determines the makeup of the ''Corrupter'' Task Force.]]
After returning to the fleet, Azzameen was promoted to [[Flight officer/Legends|flight officer]].<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> He was shortly sent out on his first [[Recon on Corrupter Task Force|reconnaissance mission]], with his objective being the Imperial task force that thwarted the ''Defiance''{{'s}} movements. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Devers (Rebel Alliance)|Devers]] assigned Azzameen to [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], and sent him and another pilot out on a mission to ascertain the location of the task force. Searching the first two probable locations with no results, Azzameen discovered the Imperials in the third area, where he discovered that the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] was none other than the Star Destroyer ''Corrupter'', commanded by Admiral Garreth Holtz, which had previously been used to capture Azzameen Home Base. Quickly identifying the rest of the craft, Azzameen destroyed Holtz's [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] before returning to the ''Defiance'' with his valuable intelligence.<ref name="xwa" />

Nammo's hit-and-fade techniques against supply convoys proved to be effective, allowing the Task Force to dedicate itself to other concerns. Word reached Nammo of a prison ship, the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[VTR-LX]]'', which was carrying Alliance prisoners taken at Hoth. Azzameen joined Red Squadron in escorting a group of Y-wings, in the hope that they could ambush ''VTR-LX'' at [[Calast]]. They were unable to stop the prison ship, but they did track it to the penal facility, [[Bundil II]]. There, the craft was [[Rescue at Bundil II|disabled]] and boarded by the [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transport]] [[Storm Unit (Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport)|''Storm Unit'']] and its [[Storm Unit (team)|team]] of commandos. Azzameen and Red Squadron fought off [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]] launched from Bundil II, and were able to safely cover ''Storm Unit'' and its quarry. Upon his return, Azzameen learned that among those rescued was Commander [[Kupalo]], a tactical expert thought lost at Hoth.<ref name="xwa" />

Aeron contacted Ace with intelligence of a stray [[Damaged Viper probe droid|Viper probe droid]] in the [[Saila Na system/Legends|Saila Na system]]. With the reasoning that such a droid may prove useful in tracking Viraxo movements, she requested that Ace retrieve the droid, and deliver it to her.<ref name="xwa" /> MK-09 was dispatched in the ''Otana'' to pick up Ace<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> and the pair headed to Saila Na, where they [[Mission to the Saila Na system|encountered]] a [[Scavenger Squadron|squadron]] of [[R-41 Starchaser]]s and the [[Muurian transport]] ''[[Pelican]]'' attempting to capture the same probe droid. Azzameen dispatched the fighters, destroyed the ''Pelican'', and collected the abandoned pod<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> before jumping to the customs checkpoint [[Tinoon Station]]. Though MK-09 hoped that the customs officials would not look too closely at the ''Otana''{{'s}} illicit cargo, Tinoon Station did wish to inspect the YT-2000 but were distracted as a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] entered the system and began [[Skirmish above Tinoon|attacking]] the station.<ref name="xwa" /> Azzameen helped to defeat the attack and the grateful customs officials allowed him to go on his way.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Ace delivered the droid to Aeron on the ''Sabra'' in the [[Zephry Asteroid field]], and returned home to the ''Defiance''. Pleased, Aeron made him a toy probe droid as a gift, but Emon managed to break it somehow.<ref name="xwa" />

When Admiral Nammo was able to suitably survey Azzameen's findings from his earlier recon mission, he learned that the ''Corrupter'' had been heavily damaged at Hoth in its attempt to bar Tomaas Azzameen from leaving the planet. It had sustained heavy [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] fire, and was in dire need of resupply.<ref name="xwa" /> Not long after Azzameen returned to the ''Defiance'',<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> the admiral dispatched [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]] from Green Squadron to destroy a supply convoy headed for the ''Corrupter'', in the hopes that they would immobilize the battleship, and buy the ''Defiance'' Task Force time to escape the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Azzameen, in his first mission in a B-wing, was able to help [[Battle of Bettel|destroy]] the convoy in the [[Bettel asteroid drift]], though the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Monitor (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Monitor'']] was able to escape to the ''Corrupter''. The Rebels, in dogged pursuit, were able to demolish the ship before it could transfer any of its technicians to the ''Corrupter'', effectively stranding Holtz and stemming his efforts to find the ''Defiance''.<ref name="xwa" /> Azzameen was later credited with the killing shot on the ''Monitor''.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

[[File:AceSensorArray-XWA-DAT15210-16.png|thumb|right|220px|Azzameen leads the attack on IOS 24.]]
Nammo felt that this was the right time for the Task Force to break free of the sector. Dispatching Green Squadron to destroy the local [[IOS 24|sensor array]] and the accompanying [[Sensor Control|control]] station, it was his hope that the confusion amongst the Imperials following the sensor blackout would buy them time for escape. Azzameen flew cover for Green Squadron in an X-wing, and allowed the B-wings to utterly [[Battle of the Anoat Main Sensor Array|pulverize]] the array and station. The four ''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transports of [[Cloak Group]] jammed all communications in the area, and the ''Defiance'' Task Force successfully made their escape. For his efforts during the campaign, Azzameen was awarded the [[Badge of Merit]].<ref name="xwa" />

====The TIE Experimental Project====
{{Quote|They were odd-looking things.|Ace Azzameen on the experimental TIE fighters|<ref name="XWA:OSG" />}}
Following the Battle of Hoth, the [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] had sustained heavy losses to its support staff. Following his excellent service on the ''Defiance'', Azzameen was transferred to the ''Liberty'', along with Commander Kupalo and several other pilots from his unit. During the transfer, the group had to make a stopover in the [[Belat system/Legends|Belat system]], where they received a panicked distress call from a nearby system. Word had spread in weeks prior of mysterious new starfighters attacking civilian convoys and leaving virtually no survivors. Azzameen investigated the distress call, and discovered heavily modified [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] attacking the civilian ''Xiytiar''-class transport ''[[Calico]]''. Rushing to the transport's aid, Azzameen and his wingmate routed the fighters and their escort, the [[Beta-class ETR-3 escort transport|''Beta''-class ETR-3 escort transport]] ''[[Suluk]]''. As soon as the convoy was deemed safe from further attack, Azzameen flew to the ''Liberty'' with this intelligence.<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:TIEExperimentalProjectMission01-XWA.png|thumb|left|220px|Azzameen engages an Experimental TIE.]]
Admiral [[Yamarus/Legends|Yamarus]], the commander of the ''Liberty'', was curious about the new TIE variants. Setting up a mock convoy of [[MB-C1 medium transport]]s, he hoped that the Imperials would be lured out into the open, allowing his pilots to capture several of the new variants. His ploy worked, and Kupalo dispatched the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] of [[Bandit Squadron]] to meet the TIEs. Azzameen, using new [[Ion missile/Legends|ion pulse warheads]] installed in his Z-95, was able to aid in the capture of several of the new craft as well as the ETR-3s that seemed to accompany them everywhere. Upon analyzing the captured craft, the Rebels learned that the new variants were in fact remote-controlled by technicians in the ETR-3s.<ref name="xwa" /> Following this mission, Azzameen was promoted to [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant junior grade]].<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

While Azzameen was taking a short break, MK-09 arrived in the ''Otana'' to take him to his Uncle Antan at the temporary Azzameen headquarters.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Antan had concocted another [[Assassination attempt on K'Armyn Viraxo|plan to wreak revenge]] on the Viraxo. His sources claimed that K'Armyn Viraxo himself would be passing through a [[Destreg Spaceport|luxury resort]] orbiting [[Destreg II]], flying his [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]], the ''[[Highroller]]'', with little to no escort. Meeting Emon in [[Destreg system/Legends|Destreg's system]], Ace waited until Viraxo entered the system. Sure enough, the ''Highroller'' exited hyperspace with a modest escort of R-41s. Rushing to engage, Ace prepared to destroy the craft, but MK-09 noted that there were no lifeforms aboard. Upon realizing that the entire situation was a trap, Emon warned Ace of an impending ambush. True to the Azzameens' fears, a mercenary component of two Muurian transports, ''[[Vembri]]'' and ''[[Tolarus]]'', along with the [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] of [[Raven Squadron]], entered the system. The ships began swarming all over the ''Andrasta'' and the ''Otana'' as Emon and Ace destroying the ''Highroller'', with Emon collecting the ship's steering wheel as a souvenir before moving to engage the attackers long enough to escape. Ace followed suit, and upon his return, Antan apologized profusely. However, he was confident that the Viraxo would start to think twice before crossing the Azzameens.<ref name="xwa" />

Admiral Yamarus learned from [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] that some of the Experimental TIEs were being developed at [[Bretie Facility]], over [[Nomlis III]], and sent out Storm Unit, along with Red and Blue squadrons, to retrieve vital data from the installation. Azzameen, in Red Squadron, [[Battle of Nomlis III|cleared]] the station's static defenses and covered Storm Unit's approach, but the situation took a turn for the worse when a group of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] entered the [[Kurdin system|system]]. Nevertheless, the Rebel squadrons were able to ensure Storm Unit's return to the ''Liberty'' with the datacore vital to the success of the mission. With the facility destroyed, production of the prototype TIEs stemmed, and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Paling]], a member of Storm Unit, thanked Azzameen for his aid at Bretie via [[e-mail]].<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:TIEExperimentalProjectMission04-XWA.png|thumb|right|220px|Azzameen participates in the defense of the ''Liberty''.]]
Shortly after, the Imperials retaliated with a punitive attack on the ''Liberty''. Yamarus and Kupalo ordered all pilots to their craft immediately, and by the time Azzameen had launched, the [[Defense of the Liberty|battle]] was raging all around the cruiser. The pilots of the ''Liberty'' were eventually able to drive off all the attackers, although they faced a new threat: [[TIE Experimental M4|TIE Bombs]], kamikaze craft that attempted to ram the ''Liberty''. Though these were also destroyed, it became apparent that there were more of these variants than had originally been thought.<ref name="xwa" /> The Rebels took heavy losses during the battle; Azzameen's own X-wing was heavily damaged and he was barely able to land it intact.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

Examination of the Bretie datacore showed that the [[TIE Experimental Project]], under the control of an Imperial [[Director/Legends|Director]] by the name of [[Lenzer]], was primarily developed at the space station [[Obsidian (XQ1 Platform)|Obsidian]]. Yamarus wanted to end the project before it could do any more damage, and dispatched Green Squadron, with Red Squadron as cover, to eliminate the project's headquarters. Upon reaching Obsidian, the Rebels encountered the [[Imperial Research Ship]] ''[[Sardis/Legends|Sardis]]'', the master control ship for all experimental TIEs, and a number of TIE starfighters. Azzameen helped destroy the ''Sardis'', Obsidian, and their accompanying craft, and was given a [[Group Commander Citation]] for his efforts.<ref name="xwa" />

====The defection of Zaletta====
{{Quote|I could not let my emotions get the better of me. I decided to save him for ATR ''Storm Unit''.|Ace Azzameen, on the capture of Kupalo|<ref name="XWA:OSG" />}}
With the TIE Experimental Project threat neutralized, the ''Liberty'' was able to rejoin the main fleet and assist in the Alliance's war effort. Alliance Intelligence contacted Admiral Yamarus with reports of a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] convoy deep in Imperial territory. As the report had come from an Imperial using an antiquated Alliance code, Yamarus, wary of a trap, dispatched Azzameen and his wingmates in Y-wings, accompanied by the X-wings of Red Squadron, to validate the report. At a planet orbited by the [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|space station]] [[Golan I (space station)|Golan I]], Azzameen identified the [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] of [[KDT Group]], disabling the vessels with slaves on board. Fighters launched from the ''Imperial II'' Star Destroyer [[Goliath (Imperial II-class)|''Goliath'']] present in the system, but Red Squadron was able to cover the rescue attempt. ''Gamma''-class assault transports from [[Tango Group]] liberated the slaves and brought them to the ''Liberty''. It was discovered that the slaves were in fact [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] who had been imprisoned for supposed crimes against the Empire.<ref name="xwa" />

Shortly after the mission, Emon set Ace up on a date with former [[Miss Liberty|Miss ''Liberty'']] [[Lady Blue]]. However, before Ace could accompany her on an outing, Lady Blue perished during a recon mission in the [[Japai system/Legends|Japai system]]. Around the same time, Aeron and MK-09 arrived on the ''Liberty'' in the ''Sabra''<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> with a proposition for Ace. Planning to raid the Viraxo orbital facility [[1]] and steal warheads, Aeron figured they could use the stolen goods to supply the Rebellion&mdash;a move with twofold benefits for the Azzameens. Ace agreed and piloted the ''Sabra'' to the Viraxo platform, eliminating its defenses. With 1 unprotected, a collection of former Twin Suns employees in [[Magnum Group]] arrived to retrieve the weapons. The Viraxo's intended customers, traveling in the [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] ''[[XTS-673]]'', arrived just as Magnum was absconding with the warheads. Allied with the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], the ''XTS-673'' sent its complement of its employer's new [[Supa Fighter]]s to engage the ''Sabra'' while the cruiser moved to bombard Magnum group. After a brief skirmish, Magnum and the ''Sabra'' escaped the system and delivered the warheads to the Alliance. Aeron found the Black Sun involvement curious, and decided to inform Antan.<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:AceKuat-XWA-DAT15210-25.png|thumb|left|220px|Azzameen leads the attack on the Kuat Facility.]]
Some time later, [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] received more transmissions from Imperial territory, using the same outdated codes as before. This time, they were told of a top secret [[Kuat Facility|research station]] in the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]]. Unsure of the station's priority, High Command ordered Yamarus to dispatch a recon group to determine the station's worth. Azzameen, along with Red Squadron, entered the [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] system, destroying the station's static defenses and communication capabilities. Based on data gleaned from inspection of the station, Yamarus ordered the destruction of the facility. Red Squadron were able to comply just as the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer [[Juggernaut (Star Destroyer)|''Juggernaut'']] entered the system.<ref name="xwa" /> Outnumbered, the Rebels cut through the middle of the Imperial line and escaped to hyperspace, with Azzameen the last to leave.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Yamarus was confident that their efforts had at least halted critical Imperial research for a while.<ref name="xwa" />

With two successful missions made possible due to the information provided by the mysterious Imperial informant, Yamarus dispatched a team to investigate the [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] [[Comm Center]], comprised of a multitude of [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] arranged in an asteroid field. Once the relay station's defenses were destroyed, Azzameen covered the [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvette]] [[Python (Assassin-class)|''Python'']]{{'s}} approach and fended off [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] attacks from the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] [[Halberd (escort carrier)|''Halberd'']],<ref name="xwa" /> before destroying the carrier itself.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> While the ''Python'' was downloading logs from the station, it received a transmission from an Imperial officer. Yamarus believed this to be the informant, and sought to investigate deeper.<ref name="xwa" />

When Antan heard of the raid on the relay station, he enlisted Aeron to install an Azzameen bug in the facility. Taking MK-09 along, she piloted the ''Sabra'' to the ''Liberty'' to meet with Ace and requested the Rebel pilot's assistance in the family mission. Ace agreed and piloted the ''Sabra'' to Comm Center, where the Azzameens discovered that the ETR-3 [[Minelayer (Beta-class ETR-3 escort transport)|''Minelayer'']] had already begun replacing the station's static defenses. Clearing these, Ace eliminated the small patrol of ''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings, while Aeron, in a [[Environment suit/Legends|zero-G suit]], planted the bug on relay satellite [[Commsat-6]], which had been compromised in the preceding Alliance mission. During the operation, the [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]] [[Omicron (shuttle)|''Omicron'']] entered the system; spotting the Azzameens, the ship deployed [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s to investigate Aeron's actions. Ace fended them off, and retrieved Aeron just as the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] [[Hurricane (Strike-class)|''Hurricane'']] exited hyperspace in an attempt to catch the trespassers. Ace evaded the Imperial forces, and returned to the ''Liberty'' unscathed. Antan was pleased with the fact that he would be able to keep tabs on the Viraxo, and word of the operation spread. [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] leader [[Koth Melan]] commended Ace for his efforts via e-mail, claiming that the Bothans respected anybody with the skill to pull off a stunt like that.<ref name="xwa" />

After the Alliance's work at Comm Center, the Imperial informant contacted the Alliance again, stating his intention to defect and supplying High Command with his location.<ref name="xwa" /> Azzameen returned to the ''Liberty'' in time to be assigned<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> to Red Squadron for an attack on outpost [[DX-11a]], in the [[Eidoloni system/Legends|Eidoloni system]], where the defector, Commander [[Zaletta]], was stationed. It was Yamarus's hope that Zaletta could safely and quietly defect during the guise of an Alliance attack. Ace, alongside the other X-wings in Red Squadron, eliminated the TIE Fighter defenses before identifying the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[AA-23]]'' as the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] carrying Zaletta. The station was destroyed, but as ''AA-23'' rendezvoused with the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], the Imperial [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Restrainer]]'' entered the system, accompanied by the Star Destroyer [[Subjugator (Imperial II-class)|''Subjugator'']]. The captain of the ''Redemption'', outraged at what seemed to be a set up, had Zaletta thrown in the brig and called the ''Liberty'' for help. Azzameen and Red Squadron [[Battle of Eidoloni|fought off]] swarms of TIE Fighters waiting for the ''Liberty''{{'s}} arrival; when the MC80 cruiser arrived, Yamarus gave the order for the ''Restrainer'' to be destroyed, which Azzameen aided in. The Alliance made a full retreat, though Zaletta's sincerity was sharply thrown into question.<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:AceKupalo-XWA-DAT15210-29.png|thumb|right|220px|Azzameen pursues ''AA-23''.]]
After the retreat, ''AA-23'', stationed in the ''Liberty''{{'s}} hangar bay 2, was commandeered by Kupalo&mdash;who had been set up as a [[Sleeper agent/Legends|sleeper agent]] by the Empire after his capture in the Battle of Hoth&mdash;who detonated a bomb in the hangar to mask his escape. Scrambling fighters to pursue, Yamarus sent Azzameen and Olin Garn to capture Kupalo. He considered the recapture of ''AA-23'' to be of top importance, due to the invaluable Imperial information it may have contained. Azzameen was able to subdue Kupalo after evading the traitor's homing mines, but before ''Storm Unit'' could retrieve the shuttle, the Star Destroyer [[Imperator (Imperial-class)|''Imperator'']] entered the system and began deploying TIEs. Azzameen and Garn fought them off, and Kupalo and his stolen shuttle were successfully apprehended. After discovering Kupalo's brainwashing at the hands of the Empire, the Alliance cleared Zaletta of all charges and integrated him into the ''Liberty''{{'s}} crew. Azzameen and Garn were highly praised by Yamarus for their part in Kupalo's capture and Azzameen was awarded the [[Mantooine Medallion/Legends|Mantooine Medallion]] for his efforts,<ref name="xwa" /> though it was officially noted that Azzameen had not donned the appropriate attire under his [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] as a result of his swift response.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

===A decorated Alliance pilot===
{{Quote|Otana, this is Aeron! Do you read? Ace, is that you?''"<br />"''We read you Aeron. Did someone call for a ride?''"<br />"''Stow it Emkay! Get your rusted bolts over here!|A panicked Aeron, trapped aboard Vergesso Base, hails MK-09|audio=R040308-10.flac|<ref name="xwa" />}}
Aeron planned to raise some funds for Antan's proposed resurrection of Twin Suns. However, she knew that Antan would not want her dealing with the Alliance, and so she kept her idea secret from him, instead contacting Ace for help. She planned to raid the Viraxo [[industrial complex]] [[VXO-33274]] for supplies she intended to deliver to the Alliance via [[Vergesso Base]], a base located within the [[Vergesso Prime/Legends|largest asteroid]] in the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso asteroid field]]. Aeron contacted several former Twin Suns employees to aid in the operation, who rendezvoused with Ace at [[Bilbringi V]], one of the [[Bilbringi Shipyards|shipyards]] located in the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]], before making their way to the Viraxo facility. [[SecForce Squadron]], comprised of [[Toscan 8-Q starfighter]]s, helped cover Ace, piloting the ''Otana'', against VXO-33274's Supa Fighter garrison. After the ''Otana'' destroyed the IPV-1 System Patrol Craft [[Scylla (frigate)|''Scylla'']], [[Juno (cargo ferry group)|Juno]] and [[Lara (group)|Lara]] groups entered the system and moved to steal containers from the facility. Aeron urged Ace and the freighters to hurry, suspecting that a Viraxo convoy would arrive soon. Sure enough, the convoy, along with [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvette]] ''[[Charybdis]]'' and [[Gundark Squadron]], entered the system and moved to engage the interloping Twin Suns craft. Fortunately, the Azzameens were able to escape, but upon reaching the Vergesso Asteroids in the [[Lybeya system/Legends|Lybeya system]], they were once again set upon by Black Sun fighters. Ace was able to destroy these, however, and drop Aeron off at Vergesso Base. She, in turn, sent the money earned from the mission on to the employees who had helped out, as well as to her Uncle Antan. Ace returned to the ''Liberty'' to await his next mission as MK-09 departed in the ''Otana''.<ref name="xwa" />

Zaletta, hoping to further prove his innocence and utility to the Rebellion, informed Admiral Yamarus of a large convoy that would be heading through the Eidoloni system. Yamarus took particular note, due to the fact that the convoy would have a large escort, which tended to deem importance in the Empire. Assigning Zaletta as the new flight officer to replace Kupalo, he had Azzameen and Garn investigate the convoy to determine its contents. Azzameen found and inspected the convoy&mdash;comprised entirely of [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]] ships&mdash;escorted by the [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigates]] [[Furious (Lancer-class)|''Furious'']] and ''[[Black Hawk]]'', and the [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyers]] [[Protector (Victory II-class)|''Protector'']] and [[Vanguard (Victory II-class)|''Vanguard'']]. Once the Alliance pilots returned to the ''Liberty'', Yamarus assessed the data, hypothesizing that the equipment being shipped may be for the construction of a new shipyard or base of operations for the Empire.<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:AceRescue-dat15210-32-XWA.png|thumb|left|220px|Ace rushes to Vergesso Prime in the ''Otana'' to save Aeron.]]
Shortly thereafter, MK-09 received an urgent distress call from Aeron in the Vergesso Asteroids, which were under [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards|attack]] from a sizable Imperial force. The family maintenance droid took the ''Otana'' and rushed to meet Ace aboard the ''Liberty'' before the pair set off for the Vergesso Asteroids.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Upon exiting hyperspace, however, Ace found himself in the midst of the ships of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]],<ref name="xwa" /> [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader's]] personal fleet,<ref name="soteb">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> under the command of Admiral [[Ledre Okins]]. The [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], along with the Imperial Star Destroyer [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] and the Victory Star Destroyers ''[[Victory 1]]'' and ''[[Victory 2]]'', laid waste to the Rebel defenses while approaching Vergesso Base itself. Ace skillfully piloted the family YT-2000 through Vader's fleet, eventually reaching the doomed asteroid base; once Aeron and some of her colleagues were aboard, Ace turned back to the wall of Imperial cruisers. Again dodging fire from starfighters and capital ships alike, the ''Otana'' successfully reached the exit vector and returned safely to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="xwa" />

====Working with the Bothan Spynet====
{{Quote|Scatter!|Ace Azzameen warning the other Blue Squadron pilots|<ref name="soteb" />}}
Black Sun contacted the Bothan Spynet, tipping them off about a highly important computer core that could be found on the freighter ''[[Suprosa]]''. In turn, Koth Melan contacted Commander [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], enlisting his help in [[Raid on the Suprosa|capturing]] the ship.<ref name="soteb" /> Skywalker, however, only had a group of Bothan pilots at his disposal, all of whom were limited in skill. Fortunately, he had one more Y-wing than he had pilots, and requested that Admiral Yamarus send a suitable pilot to fill the role.<ref name="xwa" /> Based on Azzameen's outstanding service in past campaigns, Skywalker selected him to fill the vacant spot,<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> and Azzameen flew with the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Blue Six/Legends|Blue Six]]. When the ''Liberty'' reached [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], Azzameen set out to join Commander Skywalker and Blue Squadron, who were escorting [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] and Melan in Rendar's [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]. Upon encountering the ''Suprosa'', it seemed that the ship was relatively unarmed, and the captain asserted that he was hauling nothing but fertilizer. Skywalker, unconvinced, ordered Blue Squadron to attack, but was unprepared for the ''Suprosa''{{'s}} hidden defense mechanisms. It fired a [[Diamond boron missile]] at Blue Squadron, and Azzameen called out a warning, before the missile [[Death/Legends|killed]] almost half of the Bothan pilots.<ref name="soteb" />

Pressing the attack in spite of the heavy losses, Azzameen, Rendar, and Skywalker were able to disable the craft, allowing Rendar to board and steal the computer. He was met with heavy Imperial resistance, but was able to return to the ''Outrider'' safely. Once the computer was aboard, Melan found that he was unable to decrypt the device, and requested that it be taken to a facility on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] for further investigation. Unfortunately for Azzameen and his comrades, they were pulled out of hyperspace by the Interdictor cruiser [[Claw (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|''Claw'']] en route to their destination. Trapped in the hyperspace-nullifying [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] [[Gravity well projector/Legends|created]] by ''Claw'', the Rebels were engaged by ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer [[Hunter (Victory I-class)|''Hunter'']]. Skywalker and Rendar engaged the fighters, while Azzameen and the remainder of Blue Squadron attacked the ''Claw''.<ref name="xwa" /><ref name="sotg">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref> Azzameen scored the killing shot on the ''Claw'', allowing the ''Outrider'' to jump to Kothlis while he held off the remaining Imperial fighters.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Azzameen was later contacted by Skywalker to commend him on his performance<ref name="xwa" /> and frequently spoke proudly of the mission.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

[[File:AceKothlisII-XWA-DAT15210-34.png|thumb|right|220px|The ''Executor'' prepares to destroy Kothlis II.]]
While the Bothans were able to decrypt some of the Imperial protection protocols, their attempts were cut short when a group of [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] bounty hunters [[Battle of Kothlis|attacked]] Koth Melan's safehouse, intent on claiming the large [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Skywalker's head. Melan was killed in the ensuing firefight, but he was able to dispatch his agent, [[Borsk Fey'lya]], to take the computer and get it safely away from Kothlis. The ''Liberty'', however, had detected a [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] on the edge of the system, bearing rapidly down on Kothlis, and so Admiral Yamarus ordered the evacuation of the [[Rebel Platform|orbital platform]] [[Kothlis II]] and charged Azzameen to cover the fleeing vessels. Shortly after the first ships fled the station, ships from Death Squadron&mdash;including the Super Star Destroyer ''Executor'' and Imperial Star Destroyer ''Avenger''&mdash;arrived and began their bombardment of the craft and station. Azzameen moved to engage the waves of fighters coming from the Imperial ships as the ''Executor'' destroyed the defense platform [[Sentinel (Golan defense platform)|Sentinel]], as Zaletta urged the Bothans to hasten their exit. Fey'lya, in his own ''Lambda''-class shuttle, the ''[[Fey'lya's Pride]]'', docked with the corvette [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']] transferring the data, before fleeing to the ''Liberty''. In turn, the ''Liberty'' and its fighters escaped the ''Executor'' just as Kothlis II was destroyed.<ref name="xwa" /><ref name="conf1">These events as shown in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' differ greatly from those presented in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''. In ''Rogue Leader'', the data is transferred to the [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']], but the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] is [[Battle of Kothlis|attacked]] by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''over'' [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], and instead of the [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], it is the [[Motivator (Imperial-class)|''Motivator'']]. The ''Motivator'' is attacked by the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''Redemption'', which causes it to plummet to the surface of Kothlis. There, the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] is retrieved by [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], and then, presumably, delivered to the [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']].</ref>

Unfortunately for the Alliance, the ''Razor'' was assaulted during its flight, and disabled.<ref name="xwa" /> Having only just returned to his quarters following the last mission,<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Azzameen was called to rejoin the fight as part of Blue Squadron. Entering the battle, the squadron picked off the Assault Gunboats that had stopped the corvette; the crew, unable to complete repairs of the ''Razor'' before the Imperial Star Destroyer ''Avenger'' entered the area, jettisoned the computer in an [[V33-1XP|escape pod]], though no Rebel forces were able to pick him up. The civilian ''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser [[Mercury (Dreadnaught-class)|''Mercury'']] was able to retrieve the pod, with Azzameen covering its escape to a rendezvous with the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]. They had not escaped Imperial capture yet, however, and the Super Star Destroyer ''Executor'' entered into the fray, exchanging fire with the ''Mercury'' and deploying craft to stop the escape pod on its course to the Calamari Cruiser. The ''Executor''{{'s}} efforts were in vain, however, as Azzameen picked off the TIEs and ensured the computer's safety. When the data reached Admiral Ackbar, it was determined that it was in fact [[Death Star II plans|plans]] for a new [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], which prompted High Command to disperse the fleet. For his efforts in securing the plans, Azzameen was given the [[Corellian Cross/Legends|Corellian Cross]], and was personally thanked by Ackbar, via e-mail.<ref name="xwa" /><ref name="conf1" />

====Alliance with the Smugglers====
{{Quote|I could not believe the radio. The Hurrim were going crazy shooting civilian vessels. I forgot about the freighters and targeted one of the Preybird traitors.|Ace Azzameen|<ref name="XWA:OSG" />}}
Following the Kothlis incident, the ''Liberty'' returned to the Outer Rim, in order to resupply for the inevitable attack on the new Death Star. However, the ''Liberty''{{'s}} former supply station at [[Gal Milnor]] had been destroyed by Imperial forces. Admiral Yamarus believed that the only way to keep up would be to forge an alliance with a newly formed coalition of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in the sector. Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], former [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], provided Yamarus with a contact: Dunari, owner of the profitable casino Dunari's Rest. Yamarus arranged a meeting with Dunari, and tasked Azzameen with flying cover for the Alliance delegates in [[Bandit 1|his personal Z-95 Headhunter]] outfitted with a civilian transponder.<ref name="xwa" /><ref name="SAV">{{PocketModel|set=Scum & Villainy|unit=Ace Azzameen's Z-95 Headhunter|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipsv09a.jpg}}</ref> The meeting fell under attack from both mercenaries and Imperials, but it was successfully defended, and the pact was secured.<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:AceHurrim-XWA-DAT15210-37.png|thumb|left|220px|Azzameen fires on the turncoat Hurrim.]]
One of the members of the coalition, [[Golov Nakhym]] of the [[Hurrim]], requested that the Alliance help them in a raid on a civilian convoy near [[Corvalis]], in the [[Nezni system/Legends|Nezni system]]. Yamarus dispatched Azzameen and the Y-wings of Blue Squadron to help, but the operation turned sour when the Hurrim breached their agreement with the Alliance and began attacking civilians outright. Thinking quickly, Azzameen was forced to dispatch the Hurrim [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]] before disabling the civilian freighters, allowing Alliance GR-75 medium transports entering the system to board and retrieve the civilian ships' cargo. Covering the retreat of the Alliance craft, Azzameen engaged [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] in his Y-wing bomber, a feat that not many could emerge unscathed from due to the comparative slowness of the Y-wing. Yamarus was livid about the situation, and Dunari, in turn, ejected Nakhym from his coalition.<ref name="xwa" />

After the encounter with the turncoat Hurrim, Dunari contacted Ace with news on Emon, who had been captured and held at the [[Cargo Facility 2|space station]] [[Quesna Base]]. Dunari, who had been good friends with Tomaas Azzameen during their smuggling days, felt he owed Emon's rescue to his late partner in crime. Rapidly assembling a strike team and a plan, Dunari had a bomb planted in a pressure tank at the Imperial station [[Stockyard]], which was then picked up by Ace in the ''Otana'' and delivered to Quesna Base. Upon delivery, it exploded, causing chaos amongst the station defenses and allowing Dunari to slip through in his ship, the Muurian transport ''[[Deadman's Hand]]'', and rescue Emon. Though Emon was badly beaten, Dunari's medical team at his casino helped nurse him back to health. Dunari, grateful, requested that Ace put in a good word for him with Alliance High Command.<ref name="xwa" />

Any recommendation that Azzameen could have given was soon rendered irrelevant by the Imperial [[Battle of Dunari's Rest|attack]] on Dunari's Rest. Yamarus hurriedly dispatched fighters to intercept the Imperial force, led by Admiral Holtz and the ''Corrupter''.<ref name="xwa" /> Azzameen volunteered for the mission<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> and used an X-wing to fend off Gunboats and wave after wave of TIEs, allowing Dunari's staff to safely evacuate. Dunari personally collected Emon before evacuating the station, which was shortly after taken by the Imperials.<ref name="xwa" /> During the battle, Azzameen attempted an assault on the ''Corrupter'' itself. When the Star Destroyer's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] fell, Azzameen's wingmates joined in the attack, but the arrival of the Imperial [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] [[Cerebus (Nebulon-B2 frigate)|''Cerebus'']] prompted Azzameen to order his wingmates to break off and engage the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] TIE interceptors. Within moments, the rest of Azzameen's flight group was destroyed and Azzameen was forced to break off the attack.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> It was later confirmed that the Hurrim were behind the attack; as a result, Alliance High Command took it upon themselves to find Nakhym's base and destroy it.<ref name="xwa" />

Apparently, Nakhym had already taken advantage of the attack, and had captured several members of Calrissian's smuggling coalition. Fortunately for the Alliance, several of the smugglers had escaped from the Hurrim in a stolen ''Lambda''-class shuttle, the ''[[Merte]]'', and had reached [[Camen Spaceport]]. There, they called upon Yamarus to investigate as the escapees were set upon by Hurrim pursuers. Commander Zaletta dispatched Azzameen and a wingmate to defend the shuttle until it could reach the ''Liberty'', a mission which Azzameen was able to complete with minimal damage. The escapees, fortunately, were able to provide Yamarus with the location of the Hurrim base and Yamarus quickly prepared a mission to have it destroyed.<ref name="xwa" />

By this time, Emon had fully recovered, and jumped at a chance to get back at the Viraxo. He planned to [[Mission to recover Comm Datacore|retrieve]] the old [[Comm Datacore|Azzameen Station datacore]], discarded after the family base had been Imperialized, from an Imperial junkyard so he could research Tomaas' data on their rivals. Ace, piloting the ''Otana'' alongside MK-09, slipped into the Imperial facility [[Junkyard Control]], where he found the container and sent the droid into space to retrieve the datacore as Emon flew cover in the ''Andrasta''. The Azzameens were inexplicably set upon by raiders during the operation, though Emon suspected they had been hired by the Viraxo. When MK-09 had retrieved the datacore, the Azzameens returned safely to the ''Liberty'', where they parted ways: Emon planned to study the datacore and find ways to get back at K'Armyn Viraxo while Ace continued his service in the Rebellion. Ace's efforts did not go unnoticed, as he was given honorary Bothan Spynet membership for his feat of stealth in the core recovery.<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:AceHurrimBase-XWA-DAT15210-42.png|thumb|right|220px|The Alliance attacks Hurrim Base.]]
Once back aboard the ''Liberty'', Azzameen joined the Y-wing bombers of Green Squadron as they launched an assault on the [[Hurrim Base|Hurrim base of operations]]. With cover from the X-wings of Red Squadron, Azzameen and his comrades [[Battle of Hurrim Base|destroyed]] the base's static defenses, which were built into the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] surrounding the base. Nakhym's men put up more resistance, though, in the form of the Marauder corvettes [[Broadside (Marauder-class)|''Broadside'']] and ''[[Plank]]''. Green Squadron destroyed the incoming corvettes, however, and prepared to disable the station. Golov Nakhym himself attempted to flee in the ''Lambda''-class shuttle ''[[Lendros]]''. Azzameen disabled his craft, while the Alliance Nebulon-B frigate ''[[Jericho]]'' and [[Storm Unit Group]] moved in to seize Hurrim assets. Admiral Holtz arrived in the ''Corrupter'' to end the Rebel attack, but was beaten back by the arrival of Dunari in the Dreadnaught [[Longshot (Dreadnaught-class)|''Longshot'']]. Eventually, the ''Corrupter'' was destroyed, and the Hurrim eliminated. For his efforts in the campaign against the Hurrim, Azzameen was awarded the [[Admiral of the Fleet Commendation]].<ref name="xwa" />

====Preparations at Sullust====
Hungry for intelligence on the Death Star II construction site over the Forest [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], Alliance High Command enlisted Admiral Yamarus to make [[Mission to meet Bothan delegation|contact]] with the Bothan Spynet. Councilor Fey'lya owed a debt to the Alliance following the liberation of Bothan slaves several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] prior, and so he agreed to meet with the admiral on the ''Liberty''. At the rendezvous, his ship, the Dreadnaught cruiser [[Tal'cara (Dreadnaught-class)|''Tal'cara'']], held station, while Fey'lya himself was transferred to the ''Liberty'' on the Lambda shuttle [[Jade (Lambda-class)|''Jade'']]. Shortly after the ''Jade'' launched, however, several squadrons of [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboats]] entered the system and attacked the ''Tal'cara''. Azzameen was dispatched to intercept the Blastboats, but the situation escalated when the Marauder corvette [[Intruder (Marauder-class)|''Intruder'']] joined the fray. Several [[IRD starfighter]]s attempted to destroy Fey'lya's shuttle, but Azzameen was able to stop them in time. Eventually, the ''Intruder'' was critically damaged, forcing the evacuation of its crew. The Alliance picked up one of the escape pods, and questioned the occupant, who insisted that the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] had ordered the attack. Concerned, Yamarus prompted an investigation, and Fey'lya was livid, but still agreed to pledge spies to investigate Endor.<ref name="xwa" />

Yamarus enlisted Aeron in [[Reconnaissance of mercenary base|locating]] the mercenary base, as he thought that a civilian craft and civilian operative would ensure that the investigation would stay as low-profile as possible. Aeron agreed, and took the ''Otana'', as well as MK-09, to meet Ace aboard the ''Liberty''. Ace piloted the family freighter to the orbital facility [[Cargo Station]], where, according to the captured mercenary, the bulk cruiser ''[[Redhawk]]''&mdash;a ship with ties to the [[Falcon's Nest mercenaries|mercenary group]] responsible for the earlier attack on Fey'lya&mdash;would be taking on supplies. Upon arrival, Ace docked with the ''Redhawk'' and moved to the ''Otana''{{'s}} dorsal turret as the cruiser's complement of Preybird fighters attacked. Aeron worked on [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] the ''Redhawk''{{'s}} flight logs, eventually finding the coordinates for the mercenary base, and Ace detached the ship and headed for the destination through hyperspace. Upon arrival, however, the Azzameens discovered that they had returned to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] in the center of an Imperial Weapons Testing Facility near [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] during a live-fire [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] testing of five ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers. Panicking, Aeron and MK-09 quickly plotted a course back to Cargo Station as Ace evaded swarms of TIE Fighters. Escape coordinates were found, and the ''Otana'' escaped the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] and returned to Cargo Station, where they found that the ''Redhawk'' had departed. Aeron, figuring that the mercenary cruiser had possibly left for the mercenary base, downloaded the station's logs and fed Ace new coordinates, which he followed. However, upon arrival at the new location, the Azzameens were stunned to find that the mercenary base was none other than their own former home. By then dubbed Falcon's Nest,<ref name="xwa" /> Ace began to approach the station and its surrounding mercenary craft in anger, but eventually heeded Aeron's pleading to return to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

[[File:AceHomeBase-dat15210-45-XWA.png|thumb|left|220px|Azzameen participates in the battle of Azzameen Station.]]
Upon the Azzameens' report, Admiral Yamarus planned an attack on the Home Base, hoping to recapture it for the Alliance. Emon and Aeron were invited to join the operation, while Ace flew a B-wing starfighter with his squadron. The civilian Azzameens agreed and joined the flight group in their own ships: Emon in the ''Andrasta'' and Aeron, alond with MK-09, in the ''Otana''. Once in the proximity of Falcon's Nest, Ace's B-wing group destroyed the mercenary group's static defenses, allowing the ATR-6 assault transport ''Storm Unit'' a clear path to the station. During the [[Battle of Azzameen Station|fighting]], Emon spotted Antan's ship, the [[Action IV transport]] ''[[Big Score]]'', fleeing the system, and alerted his siblings, arousing their suspicions. ''Storm Unit'' boarded the base and eliminated all resistance aboard the station. However, they discovered that someone had wired the station to self-destruct to prevent the former Azzameen Station from changing hands once more. Aeron docked the ''Otana'' with the captured base and managed to disarm the base<ref name="xwa" /> with only seconds to spare.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> Following this, Ace was given the Azzameen Family Crest, as he was considered the best pilot in the family. Thankful for the Azzameen family's continued service, the Alliance gave ownership of the liberated station to the Azzameens, who returned it to its former name and glory.<ref name="xwa" />

Shortly after this, Admiral Yamarus received a distress call from Bothans trying to leave the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. They had completed their recon mission for the Alliance, but had been stopped by the Imperial Star Destroyer [[Emancipator|''Accuser'']] and the Interdictor cruiser [[Grappler (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|''Grappler'']]. Hidden amongst a civilian convoy, the Bothans were saved by Azzameen and the other X-wing starfighters of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]],<ref name="xwa" /> who destroyed the Interdictor quickly enough for all of the Bothans to escape the ''Accuser''<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> and deliver their intelligence to Yamarus. They had discovered that a [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] on the forest moon protected the half-finished battle station, and that an Imperial ''Lambda''-class shuttle, the [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']], had the access codes to reach said generator. Yamarus decided that the capture of ''Tydirium'' was of top priority.<ref name="xwa" />

====Capture of the ''Tydirium''====
The ''Sabra'' was requisitioned for Alliance use in the capture operation. As Azzameen was the most experienced at flying freighters in his group, he, with MK-09 as copilot, piloted the commando-laden craft. Avoiding an Imperial customs checkpoint, Azzameen made his way to [[Outpost 327]] in the [[Zhar system]], where the ''Tydirium'' was docked. There, a Rebel commando team<ref name="xwa" /> led by [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]<ref name="sts">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/stealingshuttle|text=Stealing the Shuttle|int=Stealing the Shuttle}}</ref> stole the craft, while Azzameen called in [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] for backup. The ship was successfully stolen,<ref name="xwa" /> along with its Imperial access codes,<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> and Azzameen returned to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="xwa" /> Though the Empire managed to take ''Tydirium'' shortly after, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and Rogue Squadron recaptured the shuttle again,<ref name="RogueLeader">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref><ref name="chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=900#15800617|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-17|time=9:58 AM|quote=A combined effort, though 'Ace' Azzameen is the first one on the scene.}} {{C|In response to: "Who captured Tydirium first"}}</ref> and the Alliance prepared the ''Tydirium'' for use in a later mission.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> During the ''Tydirium'' mission, the Sullustans were able to prove their innocence in the mercenary debacle, and claimed that it was an Imperial machination. Fey'lya, however, was still unimpressed, but Azzameen was personally able to convince him otherwise.<ref name="xwa" />

The Alliance soon began assembling its forces for a major attack on the new Death Star.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> The [[Liberty Task Force|''Liberty'' Task Force]] was able to reach the staging point at above the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] with little diversion, but the ''Defiance'' and [[Independence task force|''Independence'']] Task Forces were not as fortunate. Admiral Yamarus [[Battle of Sullust (4 ABY)|sent]] Azzameen and Garn as part of Gold Squadron, a collection of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]], out to assist the delayed fleets. Upon rendezvous with the ''Defiance'', the Victory Star Destroyer ''[[Vagrant]]'' and the Carrack cruisers [[Xerxes (Carrack-class)|''Xerxes'']] and [[Nexus (Carrack-class)|''Nexus'']] mounted an attack. Azzameen and Gold Squadron prevented TIE Bomber squadrons from reaching the ''Defiance'' until the Mon Calamari cruiser escaped the system. Following this, Gold Squadron raced to the ''Independence'', which was under siege by a multitude of Imperial ships, including the Star Destroyers ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'', ''Protector'', and ''Vanguard''. Azzameen and the rest of Gold Squadron again kept the Alliance ship from sustaining too much damage, and it escape. Upon returning to the ''Liberty'', he was awarded the [[Star of Alderaan/Legends|Star of Alderaan]].<ref name="xwa" />

[[File:AceTydirium-XWA-DAT15210-47.png|thumb|right|220px|Azzameen escorts the ''Tydirium'' out of Outpost 327.]]
Shortly before the fleet's departure for Endor, Antan contacted Ace and his siblings, telling them that he would explain his suspicious actions of the past few months, including his appearance at Falcon's Nest. Ace, his siblings, and MK-09 journeyed to the meeting place at Azzameen Station, where Antan explained that he, on orders from the Empire, had hired the mercenaries to attack the Bothans. Antan claimed that Tomaas and Galin were still alive, and that they would have been turned over to him for his cooperation; however, that Alliance's reclamation of the family station and the subsequent dispersal of the mercenaries there jeopardized his efforts to recover the missing family members. Emon was highly skeptical, but Aeron decided to trust Antan, who [[Mission to Kessel Station|led them]] to the [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun|penal colony]] [[Kessel Station]], orbiting the oddly shaped planet of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], where Tomaas and Galin were supposedly being held. Ace docked with the station, allowing Aeron to board and investigate. As the Azzameens investigated, however, the Star Destroyer [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] entered the system, demanding the arrest of the intruding Azzameen craft. Antan, responsible for the double-cross, hailed the ''Devastator'', alerting them that Tomaas' children were to be captured, before leaving the system. Emon, enraged, commanded MK-09 to find an exit vector, a task made difficult due to the station's proximity to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]&mdash;a large collection of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] that hindered hyperspace travel. The arrival of family friend Dunari in the ''Deadman's Hand'' saved the droid the trouble, and Dunari provided the necessary escape coordinates and guided Emon, in the ''Andrasta'' and Ace, Aeron, and MK-09, in the ''Otana'', through an asteroid field and past the station [[Outpost AS-27]], providing them a route to return to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="xwa" />

====Battle of Endor====
{{Quote|Gener &hellip; er, Lando asked me if I knew how to reattach a thrust vector magnet in midflight. He muttered something about medical adhesive tape and packing foam. I told him that I didn't but that I knew someone who did. Care to come along?|Ace Azzameen asks MK-09 to join him in the Battle of Endor|<ref name="XWA:OSG" />}}
With the Alliance fleet gathered in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] and news that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was personally inspecting the Death Star II, the Rebels decided to launch their [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] on the battlestation. General [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Luke Skywalker led a [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]], ferried in the previously captured ''Tydirium'', to Endor to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] protecting the Death Star ahead of a strike by the Alliance Fleet.<ref name="RotJ" /> Azzameen was assigned to Solo's YT-1300 freighter, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], to be flown under the command of General Calrissian in the upcoming space battle. In turn, Ace asked MK-09 to accompany him aboard the ship after Calrissian asked the young pilot about repairs; the [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] complied and took position as a gunner.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> The Rebels entered the Endor system to find that the deflector shield was still up and that the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was waiting for them.<ref name="RotJ" /> As Calrissian began issuing orders to the rest of Gold Squadron in the hopes of buying some more time for the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|commando team]], he turned over control of the ''Millennium Falcon'' to Azzameen, who helped drive Imperial fighters away from the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''Redemption''.<ref name="XWA:OSG" />

The battle soon turned against the Rebels and Azzameen soon saw his former home, the ''Liberty'', destroyed by the Empire's new superweapon. On Calrissian's orders, Azzameen took the ''Millennium Falcon'' in close to the Imperial [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], assisting in the destruction of the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer [[Vehement/Legends|''Vehement'']] and the attack on the Super Star Destroyer ''Executor''.<ref name="XWA:OSG" /> The Rebels' combined attack ultimately succeeded in knocking out the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] shields and the ship was destroyed when [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Green Leader]] crashed his damaged A-wing into the bridge. By that point, the Endor strike team had destroyed the Death Star's shield generator, allowing the Rebels, including Azzameen aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'', to commence the attack on the Death Star itself by flying into the massive superstructure.
